question.text: In a scries <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>L</mi><mi>C</mi><mi>R</mi></math> resonance circuit, if we change the resistance only, from a lower to higher value :

options.text: The bandwidth of resonance circuit will increase.
The quality factor and the resonance frequency will remain constant.

solution.text:
The bandwidth of resonance circuit will increase.

As we know that Bandwidth =R/L.

Bandwidth ∝R.

So, bandwidth will increase.
